local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local energy=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Energy")
local last=energy.Value

local chime1=Instance.new("Sound")
chime1.Name="LegendaryEnergyChime"
chime1.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
chime1.Volume=.75
chime1.PlaybackSpeed=.72
chime1.Parent=SoundService

local chime2=Instance.new("Sound")
chime2.Name="LegendaryEnergySparkle"
chime2.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
chime2.Volume=.55
chime2.PlaybackSpeed=1.45
chime2.Parent=SoundService

local chime3=Instance.new("Sound")
chime3.Name="LegendaryEnergyFinish"
chime3.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
chime3.Volume=.45
chime3.PlaybackSpeed=1.9
chime3.Parent=SoundService

local token=0
local function legendaryPickup()
 token+=1
 local mine=token
 chime1:Play()
 task.delay(.07,function()
  if mine==token then chime2:Play() end
 end)
 task.delay(.15,function()
  if mine==token then chime3:Play() end
 end)
end

energy:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
 local now=energy.Value
 if now>last then legendaryPickup() end
 last=now
end)

local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local event=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GrowIslandFeedback")
event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind)
 if kind=="NotEnough" then
  -- Intentionally silent. The Core simply does not expand.
 end
end)
